status: preregistration; no encoder trained, no readout fitted on any new feature
what_this_task_is: a perception/representation study; trains image encoders, not controllers; collects no corpus; preregisters no control formulation
owner_ordering: 2026-09-26: encoder/representation work first; the look-prefix corpus later, only once a frozen encoder exposes the post-look apple
question: can a change to how the encoder is trained or read out give a frozen encoder whose features pass TASK-061's L probe (same post-look 112 px frames, readouts, unchanged TASK-059 bars) on roots the encoder never saw, and beat a random-init encoder of the same architecture

reused_unchanged.code: scripts/probe_observation_reprobe.py, src/embodied_jepa/observation_reprobe.py, scripts/probe_info_ceiling.py, src/embodied_jepa/info_ceiling.py, loaded as they are (G-hash)
reused_unchanged.frames: TASK-061 measure(): post_112 and post_112_hidden; renderer warm-up; 8-command look; G-render, G-expert, G-look, G-prior
reused_unchanged.targets: T1 reset apple xy; T2/T3 sign/value of the expert right_dx at the post-look state
reused_unchanged.readouts: info_ceiling linear + RBF kernel ridge, nested 5-fold inner CV (seed 5900 + k), lambda grid 1e-4..1e4
reused_unchanged.bootstrap: 10000 paired resamples, ic.bootstrap_indices(190), seed 5901; Wilson for T2
reused_unchanged.baselines: B-occ (TASK-059 reset visibility flag), B-maj, B-const on the post-look targets
reused_unchanged.bars: T1 median <= 1.5 cm and ratio-to-B-occ upper bound <= 0.6; T2 acc >= 0.85 and Wilson lower > B-maj; T3 MAE-ratio upper bound <= 0.6
reused_unchanged.random_floor_definition: info_ceiling.beats_random_floor: paired 95% CI of median T1 error (source - floor) upper < 0 AND T2 accuracy higher

held_out_design.method: two-way cross-fitting over the TASK-061 folds
held_out_design.encoder_e_A: trained only on train-split episodes whose root is a train root in half B; features for all 190 roots, held-out predictions only for half A
held_out_design.encoder_e_B: trained only on train-split episodes whose root is a train root in half A; features for all 190 roots, held-out predictions only for half B
held_out_design.outer_readout_for_fold_k: selected and fitted on the other 171 roots with the features of the encoder that excluded k's half
held_out_design.grouping: root episode + its branch episodes (3 for most roots, 2 for 3 roots), by root_episode_id
held_out_design.state_normalization: Welford moments over the training half's episodes only (DatasetStore.fit_normalization's method)
held_out_design.secondary_non_decisional: val roots in half h: readout fitted on the 170 train roots with e(h) features
held_out_design.E0_not_held_out: E0 was trained on all 170 train roots and selected on val; anchor and reported-only diagnostic only
held_out_design.mismatch: readouts fitted on a mix of encoder-seen and unseen roots, tested on unseen roots; expected to work against the arm

explanations.E-pool: tested by A-tok (and E0-tok, reported only)
explanations.E-collapse: tested by A-sig (SIGReg on the image feature itself; the recipe's SIGReg acts only on the fused latent)
explanations.E-supervision: tested by A-plain (privileged readout heads off)
explanations.E-capacity: argued against, not tested (image feature effective rank 3.2 of 128 on the post-look frames; equally consistent with E-collapse)
explanations.E-input: argued against, not tested (E0 patch embedding and tokens respond to the apple; a response size, not readability)
explanations.E-distribution: not separable here; a shared confound (every arm trains on the same corpus); declared

training_recipe.budget: benchmarks/manifests/apple-world-model-v4.json frozen.training: 15000 steps, batch 32, horizon 16, cosine to 0.1x; lr 3e-4, AdamW weight decay 1e-4, gradient clip 1.0
training_recipe.selection: none; the final weights of the fixed budget
training_recipe.readout_heads_and_state_fusion: as E0 (privileged readout labels of the training half only)
training_recipe.step: LeWM.train_step unchanged for R0 and A-plain; encoder_study.study_train_step for A-sig and A-rec (equals LeWM.train_step with both extra terms at weight 0)

arms_decisional_in_holm_order.training: none beyond the recipe (the R0 model)
arms_decisional_in_holm_order.feature: final patch tokens last_hidden_state[:, 1:] after the final LayerNorm, 64 x 128 = 8192-d

arms_decisional_in_holm_order.training: extra SIGReg (the model's own SIGReg module) on the image feature before state fusion, over the window's frames, weight 1.0; the recipe's fused-latent SIGReg stays 0.09

pixel reconstruction of the ImageNet-normalised 112 px first frame of each window from the 128-d image feature (before state fusion), weight 1.0; decoder Linear 128 -> 256*7*7 then 4 ConvTranspose2d (k4, s2, p1) 256-128-64-32-3 with GELU between; init torch.manual_seed(6210) in a forked RNG; own AdamW with the same lr, schedule and weight decay; joint gradient clip 1.0
readout_heads false (existing config key): prediction + multistep + SIGReg, state fusion kept; LeWM.train_step with no readout targets

reported_only_sources.F-cls: = TASK-061 L-random (seed-0 init, heads on, digest cae0ad88...); floor for A-sig and A-rec; anchor
reported_only_sources.F-tok: seed-0 init final patch tokens; floor for A-tok
reported_only_sources.R0-cls: recipe unchanged, cross-fitted, probe feature; control
reported_only_sources.E0-tok: frozen E0 final patch tokens; cheap readout test of E-pool before any training; NOT held out, never decisional
reported_only_sources.F-plain: seed-0 init with readout heads off (digest f760fb42...), probe feature; floor for A-plain

pass_rule: trained: both encoders complete 15000 steps within 7200 s each, with finite losses

not collapsed: for each encoder, the image feature (probe feature; R0's for A-tok) on 1024 frames of its own training half (seed 6220): collapsed_fraction <= 0.05, effective_rank >= 2, latent_std_mean >= 0.1 (VisualModel _statistics); reference: E0 image feature 0.876 / 0.000 / 7.0, seed-0 init 0.013 / 0.266 / 8.5 (calibration-v2)
succeeds on all 190 roots under the unchanged bars
not spurious (apple-hidden check, per-half hidden features; ablation renderer reproduces 190/190)

multiplicity.method: Holm step-down over the 4 decisional arms, family-wise one-sided alpha 0.025
multiplicity.p_value: p_arm = max(p_T1, p_T2, p_T3, p_F); p_T1..p_T3 = observation_reprobe.hypothesis_pvalues unchanged; p_F = share of the same 10000 paired resamples with median(arm error) - median(floor error) >= 0; p_arm = 1 if T1 median > 1.5 cm, T2 accuracy < 0.85, or T2 accuracy not higher than the floor's; p_arm = 1 for a not-evaluated arm
multiplicity.ties: listed order A-tok, A-sig, A-rec, A-plain

qualifiers_not_rows.unadjusted_only: meets the bars and the floor but not Holm
qualifiers_not_rows.bars_not_floor: meets the bars, not the floor
qualifiers_not_rows.partial_information: beats the prior on all roots without succeeding
qualifiers_not_rows.collapse_demoted: meets the bars but fails the collapse gate

diagnostics_reported.collapse: _statistics of the image feature and the flattened final tokens on 1024 training-half frames (seed 6220) and on the 190 post-look frames
diagnostics_reported.action_sensitivity: 512 training-half windows, horizon 8, seed 6230: median over windows of ||z8(a) - z8(a_perm)|| / ||z8(a) - z8_true||, a_perm a seeded derangement of the windows' actions
diagnostics_reported.label_free_table: the calibration statistics for every trained encoder on the roots of its own held-out half

reproduction_anchors.compared: every field of results[name] produced by evaluate_source and the strata masks (primary per stratum, secondary, selections) and per_root xy/dx/dy predictions
reproduction_anchors.void: any T2 count, pass/fail flag, succeeds/beats_prior reading or selection differs, or numeric max |delta| > 1e-6: G-anchor fails, V; the owner is told before any repeat
reproduction_anchors.caveat: 0 < max |delta| <= 1e-6 with every count, flag and selection identical: continue; reproduction caveat; escalated to the owner before the results document; no row change
reproduction_anchors.machine: the same machine as TASK-061 run-1

guards_void_the_run.G_hash: every file in hashes matches; episode files checked before decoding; E0 and random encoder digests match TASK-061's; clean tree
guards_void_the_run.G_split: TASK-061 G-split (190 roots, fold hash) plus: every training episode is in the train split, its root_episode_id is a train root of the encoder's training half, never a root of the half for which the encoder produces held-out predictions; e(A) and e(B) training root sets are disjoint and together exactly the 170 train roots; no val, test or holdout episode is decoded for training
guards_void_the_run.G_render_G_expert_G_look_G_prior: TASK-061's, unchanged; the calibration renderer's post-look frames must equal measure()'s
guards_void_the_run.G_anchor: reproduction_anchors, including the stage code reproducing TASK-061's E0 and L-random features exactly
guards_void_the_run.G_init: before training every model's weight digest equals its architecture's seed-0 digest (heads on cae0ad88..., heads off f760fb42...); every floor's features come from a model with that digest

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.condition: a guard fails (incl. G-anchor) or the run stops before a complete report (crash, global wall cap)

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.reading: a changed objective, regime or supervision gives LeWM's own 128-d image latent the apple on held-out roots, beyond random init
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.next: preregister the look-prefix 112 px corpus with that arm's recipe as the encoder (several pass: smallest p_arm, ties listed order); no control formulation until the retrained encoder passes this probe on that corpus's decision frames

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.condition: A-tok passes, no other arm does
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.reading: the recipe's tokens carry the apple beyond random init; its pooled latent does not
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.next: preregister the look-prefix corpus plus, separately, a LeWM variant whose latent is the token grid (or a pooling that keeps it)

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.condition: no arm passes and at least one arm was not evaluated (mechanical failure)
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.reading: the failed arms' explanations are untested
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.next: the abandonment clause does not fire; the owner decides whether a disclosed amendment re-runs the unevaluated arm(s)

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.condition: no arm passes, every arm evaluated, at least one arm succeeds (bars) and is not spurious
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.reading: features of an evaluated arm expose the apple but no arm meets every pass condition (floor, Holm or collapse gate)
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.next: the abandonment clause fires; one preregistered test of an externally pretrained frozen encoder against its own random-init floor on this probe, before any corpus

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.condition: no arm passes, every arm evaluated, no arm succeeds without being spurious
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.reading: no tested change to the readout point, regime, objective or supervision gives a frozen encoder that exposes the apple on held-out roots
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.next: the abandonment clause fires; as O-ENC-ARCH; if that also fails, no look-prefix corpus, and the remaining route is the overview camera (a hardware/workspace change)

abandonment_clause: under O-ENC-ARCH or O-ENC-NONE the line 'train a LeWM-family encoder on apple-wide-v1 train-split frames so that its frozen features expose the post-look apple' is closed: no further readout-point, regularisation, objective or supervision variant of the TASK-054 recipe is preregistered on this corpus without new evidence of a different kind; capacity, input handling and the shared E-distribution confound are recorded as untested (argued against, not refuted); the LeWM backend, the encoder as a component and the product goal are not abandoned

void_rule.void: any stop before a complete report (guard, crash, global wall cap) is V; nothing in it is read
void_rule.repeat: exactly one from-scratch repeat into run-2: same seeds, caps and device, clean tree, every encoder retrained; MPS training is not bit-deterministic (weight digests recorded); any fix limited to runner mechanics via a reviewed PR and a fresh pre-run GO
void_rule.owner_rulings: recorded with a UTC timestamp before the run they affect

budget.reference: E0's full-data run took 3512 s including 16 validation passes (checkpoints/task054-wm-v4/leworldmodel_baseline.run.json)

process.reported_verdicts_only: A gated run starts only on the pre-run reviewer's REPORTED verdict, delivered as a message - never on a review file read from disk. Same rule for merging: only on the reviewer's reported APPROVE.
process.one_task_one_agent: One task, one agent. Do not launch a closeout/follow-up agent while the original task agent can still resume.
process.post_freeze_defects: escalated to the task owner; fixed only by disclosed amendment

loss_terms_on_fused_latent: privileged readout heads incl. palm_minus_apple, apple_minus_plate (core) and absolute apple_position (auxiliary, weight 0.5)

arm_states.not_evaluated: an encoder hit the per-encoder cap or a non-finite loss/gradient; never probed; cannot pass; p_arm = 1
arm_states.collapse_demoted: both encoders trained, the collapse gate fails for at least one; probed and reported; cannot pass
arm_states.evaluated: both encoders trained and the gate holds

limitations_declared: each encoder sees half the train roots
one training run per arm and half; seed variance not measured
no training on post-look frames (E-distribution a shared confound)
E0 not held out: anchor and diagnostic only
capacity and input handling argued against, not tested

superseded.note: the draft labelled the energy ratio a 'variance fraction' and divided by 2n; v1 had no collapse reference; every S value and effective rank is identical across the three, and v1's and v2's representations blocks are identical in every field
